## Adding or checking playgrounds?

Delete this section if the pull request doesn't touch playground data. Otherwise, tick each source type you checked for every district involved (see docs/finding-playgrounds.md):

- [ ] District or borough council play area directory (every category and the A to Z)
- [ ] District or borough council parks and leisure sites page
- [ ] Leisure operators running council sites (Better, Everyone Active, Places Leisure, Fusion and others)
- [ ] ParksHerts, or the county's park portal, searched town by town
- [ ] Town councils
- [ ] Parish councils (all of them in the district)
- [ ] Unitary, metropolitan or London borough: its country parks and countryside sites, and its housing-estate play areas
- [ ] Trusts, the county council, National Trust, English Heritage, Historic Houses, private attractions
- [ ] Cross-checked against OpenStreetMap `leisure=playground` for missing candidates
